import json
import pandas as pd
import igraph as ig

path = "/tmp/t2a-pr-k3IuVo/work/pokec_refresh/live/soc-pokec-relationships.txt"

# Reuse the graph from the earlier cell if it still exists; otherwise rebuild it
if "g" not in globals():
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+", header=None, names=["src", "dst"],
                     dtype="int64", engine="c")
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(pd.concat([df["src"], df["dst"]], ignore_index=True))
    m = len(df)
    src_idx, dst_idx = codes[:m], codes[m:]
    n = len(uniques)
    g = ig.Graph(n=n, edges=list(zip(src_idx.tolist(), dst_idx.tolist())), directed=True)

membership = g.connected_components(mode="weak")
n_wcc = len(membership)
sizes = sorted(membership.sizes(), reverse=True)

print("nodes appearing in edges:", g.vcount(), "edges:", g.ecount())
print("weakly connected components:", n_wcc)
print("largest component sizes:", sizes[:5])

answer = {
    "answer": n_wcc,
    "assumptions": {
        "directed": True,
        "weighted": False,
        "use_weights": False,
        "largest_component_only": False,
        "measure": "weakly connected components (igraph connected_components, mode=weak)",
        "node_universe": "ids appearing in the edge file (isolated users in node table excluded)",
        "largest_component_size": sizes[0],
    },
    "clarification": None,
}
print(json.dumps(answer))

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import igraph as ig

path = "/tmp/t2a-pr-k3IuVo/work/pokec_refresh/live/soc-pokec-relationships.txt"

# Recover the original-id mapping for vertex indices (same factorize order as the graph build)
if "uniques" not in globals():
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+", header=None, names=["src", "dst"],
                     dtype="int64", engine="c")
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(pd.concat([df["src"], df["dst"]], ignore_index=True))
    m = len(df)
    if "g" not in globals():
        g = ig.Graph(n=len(uniques), edges=list(zip(codes[:m].tolist(), codes[m:].tolist())), directed=True)
    del df

pr = np.asarray(g.pagerank(directed=True, damping=0.85, weights=None))
order = np.argsort(-pr, kind="stable")[:10]
top_ids = [int(uniques[i]) for i in order]
top_scores = [float(pr[i]) for i in order]

print("top 10 PageRank (id, score):")
for rank, (i, s) in enumerate(zip(top_ids, top_scores), 1):
    print(rank, i, round(s, 8))

answer = {
    "answer": top_ids,
    "assumptions": {
        "directed": True,
        "weighted": False,
        "use_weights": False,
        "largest_component_only": False,
        "measure": "PageRank (igraph pagerank, damping=0.85, directed, unweighted)",
        "node_universe": "ids appearing in the edge file",
        "scores": top_scores,
    },
    "clarification": None,
}
print(json.dumps(answer))

import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import igraph as ig

path = "/tmp/t2a-pr-k3IuVo/work/pokec_refresh/live/soc-pokec-relationships.txt"

if "g" not in globals() or "uniques" not in globals():
    df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=r"\s+", header=None, names=["src", "dst"],
                     dtype="int64", engine="c")
    codes, uniques = pd.factorize(pd.concat([df["src"], df["dst"]], ignore_index=True))
    m = len(df)
    g = ig.Graph(n=len(uniques), edges=list(zip(codes[:m].tolist(), codes[m:].tolist())), directed=True)
    del df

indeg = np.asarray(g.indegree())
order = np.argsort(-indeg, kind="stable")[:10]
top_ids = [int(uniques[i]) for i in order]
top_counts = [int(indeg[i]) for i in order]

# Check for ties at the cutoff so the top-10 boundary is clear
cutoff = top_counts[-1]
n_at_cutoff = int((indeg == cutoff).sum())

print("top 10 by in-degree (id, in-degree):")
for rank, (i, c) in enumerate(zip(top_ids, top_counts), 1):
    print(rank, i, c)
print("in-degree at cutoff:", cutoff, "nodes with that in-degree:", n_at_cutoff)

answer = {
    "answer": top_ids,
    "assumptions": {
        "directed": True,
        "weighted": False,
        "use_weights": False,
        "largest_component_only": False,
        "measure": "in-degree (number of incoming friendship edges, igraph indegree)",
        "node_universe": "ids appearing in the edge file",
        "in_degrees": top_counts,
        "ties_at_cutoff_count": n_at_cutoff,
    },
    "clarification": None,
}
print(json.dumps(answer))
